feedback.problem:
Calculate the minor of the entry ${d}_{23}$ in the matrix
$D=[\begin{aligned}10 & 2 & 5 \\ -12 & 44 & -33 \\ 25 & 30 & 41\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
The minor of ${d}_{23}=-33$ (second row, third column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $-33$ are removed: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}10 & 2 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & -33 \\ 25 & 30 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${d}_{23}=-33$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}10 & 2 \\ 25 & 30\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}10 & 2 \\ 25 & 30\end{aligned}| \\  & =10\cdot 30-2\cdot 25 \\  & =300-50 \\  & =250.\end{aligned}
$$
